## MockTelegramServer.webhookSecretToken property

`secret_token` registered through `setWebhook`<!-- -->, replayed on every outbound webhook POST.

**Signature:**

```typescript
webhookSecretToken: string | undefined;
```

## Remarks

Real Telegram sends `X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token` on each webhook delivery, and `Gramstax` rejects deliveries without it whenever `optionsDeploy.webhook.secretToken` is set. Omitting the header here made `_postUpdate` unusable against such a bot (every call 401s), so the mock now mirrors the header the same way Telegram does.
